newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing debt market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing debt market report.

text.p: Dutch bonds closed sharply higher on Wednesday, hoisted by a late rally in Germany where bund futures charged through key resistance.
"The market has been heavy for most of the morning. Now we're seeing a lot of buying coming in," said one dealer as the bund future broke up through the 98.00 chart level.
One trader said most activity was in the futures with only light trading in the cash market but another said the rally sparked buying interest in guilder paper.
A broker said bonds briefly dipped on news Iraq fired at U.S. jets over northern Iraq today but they soon recovered.
"At this moment, we see some buying coming in," he said, attributing the rally to short-covering.
He said demand was greatest for 2002-2003 paper with buyers reluctant to move shorter or longer on the yield curve.
One dealer said bund futures had been bobbing between 96.80 and 97.00 for most of the day but an upward break late in the day produced hectic activity.
Dealers said the market was still awaiting U.S. data on Thursday and Friday for indications of the direction of interest rates amid expectations of a discount rate hike.
